clips.title: The story
paras: Ken'zigla's Draught is a potent, foul-tasting medicinal tonic prepared by Ken'zigla in the Stonetalon Mountains. It is formulated to restore enough strength to critically wounded individuals so they can move without bleeding out.

Prepared by Ken'zigla in the Stonetalon Mountains, this potent brew serves as an emergency restorative for those on the verge of death. The tonic is extremely strong and must be measured carefully; drinking more than half a dose at once risks causing the patient to bleed out as their circulation surges. Administering half provides enough raw vigor to move and flee imminent danger, while the remainder must wait until the body stabilizes after a full night's rest.
